title: Per-kernel parametric theta-vector
description: Closed-object schema for the per-kernel five-dimensional parametric model fit `(theta_compute, theta_hbm_bw, theta_l2_bw, theta_l1_bw, theta_latency_floor)`, fit via perturbation sweeps with NVML covariate regression as the X-matrix. Each component carries a confidence interval; a component fit whose CI exceeds the pre-registered maximum width is labeled `theta_component_unreliable` and excluded from downstream prediction consumers. A prediction model must produce theta_pred matching theta_meas within the pre-registered per-component tolerance for the kernel to count as `theta_match`.

perturbation_sweep_id.description: Identifier for the perturbation sweep this fit was executed against; the sweep specification is a frozen pre-registration artifact.

covariate_regression_residual_variance_r.description: Residual-variance reduction (in percent) achieved by the NVML covariate regression layer at the time of fit. Recorded for provenance; downstream consumers MAY use the regression but MUST surface the value in their per-host provenance.

fit_status.description: Per-vector fit admissibility. `theta_fit_undersampled` excludes the entire vector from downstream prediction comparison.

ci_width.description: Width of the per-component confidence interval. Interval-width thresholds are registered in the pre-registration TOMLs; a component whose ci_width exceeds the registered maximum is set to `theta_component_unreliable`.
